steps.text: Your last morning began like any other.
A grey window. Somewhere to be. The small weather of an ordinary life.
You do not remember the moment it ended. Only that it did.
Then light. Falling embers. A shape reassembling out of the dark, a shape that used to be you.
Pines overhead. The smoke of a burning mountain at your back. And a voice.
You come to beneath the pines, the smoke of Emberfall still at your back.
Aldric:  Easy, now. You walked a long way just to fall down in an old man's glade.
Aldric:  They called me something once, down in the low country. A hero, if you believe the songs. I stopped believing them.
Aldric:  So I came up here, to the quiet, and let the trees forget my name for me.
Aldric:  But the quiet's ending. South of here the mountain burns, the volcano is waking, and its embers reach for the town.
Aldric:  Someone has to go down into that fire and end it. And you have the look of someone with little left to lose.
Aldric:  I've three old arms left in me. A blade, a wand and focus, a bow with a hundred arrows. I'll not make you choose, take them all.
Aldric:  Draw whichever calls to you. Your hand knows its own skills, and the bar will change to match the weapon you hold.
Aldric:  Good. Learn which one you are. Fish the lake, warm yourself, live a little. The mountain will still be waiting.
